papers.title: Shared evolution
pages: Abstract: comparison of two evolution kernels.
Assumptions: both kernels share the same anomalous dimension. Their difference is scale independent under this condition.
Method: CASCADE pseudodata are used. This is not an extraction from experimental measurements.
